title: Beyond Point Predictions: Uncertainty-Aware Satellite Poverty Mapping for Public Policy
abstract: arXiv:2608.23322v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite their critical importance for policy and research, high-resolution poverty data remain limited across much of Africa. Machine learning (ML) with earth observation (EO) imagery has recently emerged as a way to supplement these data by predicting (i.e., estimating) poverty where it has not been directly measured. Yet to be used reliably, decision-makers and analysts need assurances that they will not be misled by the errors in these predictions. To meet this need, we develop an uncertainty-aware EO-ML method for poverty mapping based on simultaneous quantile regression and a novel form of conformal prediction. Using a spatiotemporal transformer trained on sequences of Landsat and nighttime-light images, we produce prediction intervals for neighborhood-level International Wealth Index estimates across Africa which are statistically guaranteed to achieve their desired coverage rates. translated_title: 超越点预测：面向公共政策的不确定性感知卫星贫困制图
translated_abstract: 尽管贫困数据对政策制定和研究至关重要，但非洲大部分地区的高分辨率贫困数据仍然有限。近年来，机器学习结合地球观测图像已成为一种补充这些数据的方法，通过预测（即估算）未直接测量地区的贫困状况。然而，为了可靠使用，决策者和分析师需要确保不会被这些预测中的错误所误导。为满足这一需求，我们开发了一种基于同时分位数回归和一种新颖的共形预测形式的不确定性感知EO-ML贫困制图方法。利用在Landsat和夜间灯光图像序列上训练的空间时间变换器，我们为非洲社区级别的国际财富指数估计生成了预测区间，这些区间在统计上保证达到期望的覆盖率。尽管我们方法的点预测性能...
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合分位数回归和共形预测的不确定性感知卫星贫困制图方法，为非洲社区级贫困估计提供统计保证的预测区间，以支持公共政策决策。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an uncertainty-aware satellite poverty mapping method combining quantile regression and conformal prediction, providing statistically guaranteed prediction intervals for neighborhood-level poverty estimates in Africa to support public policy.
